page.content:
Albe was a famous artist who painted the portrait of the Old Duke of House Atreides. The painting was hung on one end of the dining hall in the Arrakeen governor's palace when the Atreides moved to Arrakis.

page.overview:
Who is Albe?

Albe was a famous artist who painted the portrait of the Old Duke of House Atreides. The painting was hung on one end of the dining hall in the Arrakeen governor's palace when the Atreides moved to Arrakis.
